title: Energy Measurement and Optimization of TinyML in Resource-Constrained Embedded Systems: A Systematic Mapping Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.07264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT) has increased the volume of data generated at the network edge, where many devices operate under severe memory, processing, and energy constraints. In this context, Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) enables machine learning (ML) tasks to be executed on microcontrollers, smart sensors, and other resource-constrained platforms. However, the literature remains heterogeneous regarding the algorithms evaluated, energy-measurement methods, reported metrics, influencing factors, and optimization strategies. This study presents a systematic mapping of energy-aware TinyML research. It identifies the main models and learning approaches, classifies energy-evaluation methodologies and metrics, examines the technical factors affecting energy consumption, and organizes the reported optimization techniques into a structured taxonomy. The findings highlight the frequent use of convolutional and lightweigh

translated_title: 资源受限嵌入式系统中TinyML的能耗测量与优化：一项系统性映射研究
translated_abstract: 物联网的快速扩张增加了网络边缘产生的数据量，而许多设备在严苛的内存、处理能力和能耗限制下运行。在此背景下，微型机器学习使机器学习（ML）任务能够在微控制器、智能传感器和其他资源受限平台上执行。然而，现有文献在所评估的算法、能耗测量方法、报告的指标、影响因素以及优化策略方面仍呈现异质性。本研究对能耗感知的TinyML研究进行了系统性映射，识别了主要的模型和学习方法，对能耗评估方法和指标进行了分类，考察了影响能耗的技术因素，并将已报道的优化技术整理为结构化的分类体系。研究结果凸显了卷积神经网络和轻量化（模型）的频繁使用……
tldr: 该研究通过系统性映射方法全面梳理了能耗感知的TinyML研究领域，构建了涵盖主要模型与学习方法、能耗评估方法与指标、技术影响因素以及优化技术的结构化分类体系。
en_tdlr: This study presents a systematic mapping of energy-aware TinyML research, providing a structured taxonomy of main models, energy-evaluation methodologies, technical factors affecting energy consumption, and optimization techniques.
